edits.old: Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003
edits.new:
Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC5 Access refused for a role without the right (exception X1)
    Given a role without the right in capability area Treatment and offer
    When it reads the signed treatment
    Then it is refused with 403 before any read
    Then the refusal is logged by the guard library and the user sees MSG-P4-002

  Scenario: AC6 No signature (exception X2)
    Given a case in state OFFER_WITH_CUSTOMER
    When CUSTOMER_SIGNED arrives with signed = N, or with no signature fact
    Then no rule of this story fires
    Then the case stays in the offer state

  Scenario: AC7 Signature after the offer timer fired (exception X3)
    Given a case in state OFFER_WITH_CUSTOMER and the offer timer has fired
    When CUSTOMER_SIGNED arrives
    Then the stage does not route the case to operations
    Then the user sees MSG-S2-003

  Scenario: AC8 Signature not verified on a restructure (exception X4)
    Given a case in state OFFER_WITH_CUSTOMER
    When CUSTOMER_SIGNED arrives with signed = Y and the signature not verified
    Then R-RES-16 does not fire and nothing is written
    Then the case stays in OFFER_WITH_CUSTOMER

  Scenario: AC9 Field refused by the library (exception X6)
    Given the decision record library refuses a record field
    When the action is taken
    Then nothing changes and the field is named
    Then the case stays in the offer state and the user sees MSG-P7-009

  Scenario: AC10 Hand-over not satisfying the published element (exception X7)
    Given a hand-over element that does not satisfy RWB-S2-E3008-CON
    When the apply step validates it
    Then the apply step fails validation before the child completes and the workflow retries
    Then no partial element leaves the stage and the message MSG-GEN-001 is raised

  Scenario: AC11 Same signal delivered twice (exception X8)
    Given the same signal is delivered twice
    When the stage handles both deliveries
    Then one signature status, one decision record and one hand-over exist
    Then the first answer is returned

edits.old: BR9 is why no approval step appears in the flow.

BR9 is why no approval step appears in the flow.

**Open decision DL10.** DL10 is still open. Its assumptions ASM-2250, ASM-2357, ASM-2377 and ASM-2863 are taken as stated until DL10 is decided.

**Reference data.** The list LOV-TRT-SIGNATURE gives the values of `signature_status` (BR4). The parameters of BR3, namely the two target states, the rule IDs, the rule versions and the one-working-day timer, are read through the parameter and reference-data contracts of DP-06 and DP-07 and never written as constants.
